---
name: Explain Added Code
description: "Briefly explain code that was added or changed for the current task"
agent: agent
---
Review the code added or changed for the current task and explain it in plain
language.

Use no more than four short bullet points covering:

- What the code does.
- The main components that changed.
- How the main request or data flow works.
- How to run or verify it.

Keep the explanation high-level. Do not provide a line-by-line walkthrough or
repeat implementation details.
